findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Arbitrary file write via zip extraction
 * @description Detect use of zipfile extraction that may allow path traversal when handling workbooks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/openpyxl-zip-traversal
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-22
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("zipfile").getMember(["ZipFile", "PyZipFile"]).getACall()
select call, "Review zipfile usage to ensure no unsafe extraction of attacker-controlled archives (path traversal)."
findings.hypothesis: Potential unsafe zipfile usage leading to directory traversal
